title: effect registry and templates
description:

adding a develop effect, each validated by reference against the real
commits that shipped the pattern in this repository.

with the const-ban on uniform-derived locals, FRAGMENT_COVERED_STAGES
gate, registry row), the verbatim GLSL block, the host parity
